issue.title: [Bug]:  explore探索技能永远会失效，因为Reasonix框架试图解析不存在的参数 | explore subagent always fail because Reasonix try to parse invalid arguments
issue.body: ### Version line v2 — Go rewrite (1.x), main-v2 (active development) ### Exact version 1.24.1 ### What happened? Deepseek试图探索代码库时会启动explore。在**1.24.1**版本中，启动explore会直接报错。1.24.0版本无此错误。 When Deepseek try to explore codebase it will use explore subagent. However in version **1.24.1** the explore will immediately fail with the following error. This WILL NOT HAPPEN in **1.24.0**. { "action": "call", "capability_id": "skill:explore", "arguments": "{\"task\": \"全面探索 PicAnnotateCenter 在代码库中的位置、角色、结构和用法。需要找到：\\n1. PicAnnotateCenter 组件/模块的定义位置\\n2. 它的主要功能和职责\\n3. 它依赖了哪些其他模块/组件\\n4. 哪些地方使用了它（引用者）\\n5. 它的 props、事件、状态等接口\\n\\n请搜索以下模式：\\n- grep \\\"PicAnnotateCenter\\\" 在全代码库\\n- 查找相关文档\\n- 分析其目录结构\\n- 找到其父组件和子组件关系\\n\\n请返回一份详细的分析报告。\"}" } invalid args: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type struct { Name string "json:\"name\""; Arguments string "json:\"arguments\""; Continue string "json:\"continue_from\""; Fork string "json:\"fork_from\"" } 根本原因是这是一个explore探索任务，但Reasonix试图从参数中解析不存在的name arguments continue_from fork_from这四个参数 ### Steps to reproduce 1. 启动Reasonix，在任意代码库要求Agent探索代码。 2. Agent启动skill:explore，并立刻收到调用失败错误。 ### OS / platform Windows 11 ### Relevant logs or output ```shell ```

steps: Create a tiny local JavaScript project with src/PicAnnotateCenter.js exporting a function named PicAnnotateCenter, src/main.js importing it, and a README describing it.
请用 explore 探索任务全面探索 PicAnnotateCenter 在代码库中的位置、角色、结构和用法。需要找到它的定义、主要职责、依赖、引用者及接口，返回详细分析报告。
expected: The explore capability accepts the advertised arguments and returns a repository analysis.
defect: skill:explore fails immediately because JSON-string-wrapped capability arguments are unmarshaled into the wrong nested struct.
Root cause: The capability dispatcher attempts to decode the string-valued arguments as a struct with name/arguments/continue_from/fork_from instead of normalizing the requested explore task. #8553 normalizes skill capability arguments in the 1.x history.
